_readme: FILE 2 of 2 — 'JSON AI GIVES ME' + 'JSON I SEND TO FRONTEND'. Shows (A) the raw JSON the AI replies with, and (B) the validated, wrapped response this backend sends to the frontend. Built in src/modules/ai/chat.controller.ts, src/modules/analysis/*, wrapped as { success, data }. Example repo: github.com/hagopj13/node-express-mongoose-boilerplate (MERN).

part_A_rawAiReply_analyze._note: What the model returns for the analyze call. Parsed by extractJson() then validated by architecture.schema.ts — invalid shapes are retried once, then fall back to heuristic mode.

frontendGuarantees: ids are stable kebab-case slugs, unique within one analysis
every connection.from/to references an existing component id

part_B_toFrontend_chat._note: AI prose + TARGET_COMPONENT + PATH lines are parsed; every id is re-validated against stored architecture before sending. Also emitted over Socket.IO as event 'character:explain'.

data.answer: Authentication starts at auth-routes, which delegate register/login requests to the auth controller. Protected routes pass through auth middleware that validates the JWT before the handler runs. The controller verifies credentials against the user model, which persists accounts to MongoDB.

fieldRules: path: ordered walk of component ids (drives character animation in 3D map)
relatedComponents: neighbor ids, all guaranteed to exist in latest architecture

details.message: String must contain at least 2 character(s)
